description: Use this to answer: "Show me every store price for <game>", "How much does <game> cost at Steam, GOG, Epic...?", "Compare prices for <game>". Returns all current offers with the real price (list price plus checkout fees), edition, platform and notes, in Fairly's price-only ranking order. For a single recommendation call get_cheapest_way_to_play instead.

currency.description: Currency: USD, EUR, GBP or TRY. Default is the region's currency.

game_id.description: Steam AppID (e.g. 730) or IGDB id (e.g. igdb:1942).

region.description: Region: tr, us, eu or gb. Default: detected from the caller's IP, us when unknown.

name: get_offers
